info.prompt: Ethereal wide shot of **RALLY FREE cooperative mode** — the **nine-by-nine grid** glows under **neural lattice pathways** connecting player roles: **Rainmaker** selecting a target color via hovering **amber gold cursor**, **Headhunter** obliterating **granite Stone Blockers** in one hit, **Archivist** recovering Farkle Pool points as **emerald green trails**, and **Conductor** extending the **three-second reaction timer** with **crimson aura**. The **Continue/Bank/Pass decision UI** pulses with **cathedral chord arpeggios**, while unbanked points swirl dangerously above the board like a **neon storm**.
